title: BEST MOB & XP FARM In Minecraft Tutorial - EASY & FAST - 69,000/HR!
description:
📝Important Details About This Farm :
📚This farm is easy to build and can produce +69,000 ( Drops )
 Drops Per Hour! this farm is looting based mob/xp farm
📚This farm is non redstone circuit which makes this farm the best choice for beginners but even with redstone this farm is faster and the rate is extremely fast!
📚This farm is so fast and I highly recommend this farm to beginners.
📚This module uses a boat to activate and trigger it has a clock but the setup has a specific amount of delay to be activated and it does not even use a dispenser
📚This farm exactly uses a similar method to stacking raid farms to push mobs into the chambers except this one will be pushed at once this makes the farm so fast because if we think about it the water-pushing method will take time to push mobs to the chamber!
